page_title: OSA 2-2 ALA | Osasuna v Alaves 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' What was Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+6' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+5' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball.
90+4' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Lucas Torro and he is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is coming onto the pitch as Jon Guridi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
86' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
85' A fine pass finds Raul Garcia (Osasuna) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Antonio Sivera reacts superbly to deny him.
84' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Toni Martinez (Alaves) replaces Kike Garcia.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kike Barja (Osasuna) will replace Ruben Garcia.
79' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Osasuna.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:6.
71' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' 2 - 2 Goal! Carlos Vicente puts the ball on a plate for Kike Garcia (Alaves), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:2.
67' Substitution. Carlos Martin walks off the pitch and Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.
67' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Osasuna was in an offside position.
65' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
61' 2 - 1 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Antonio Sivera stranded. 2:1.
60' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
60' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Antonio Blanco (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
59' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
59' The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
58' 8:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
57' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) has a goal ruled out for offside!
54' 1 - 1 GOAL! The corner comes over and Alejandro Catena wins a simple header before Ante Budimir (Osasuna) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.

54' Excellent touch by Jesus Areso (Osasuna)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
53' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
52' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
51' The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.

47' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Antonio Sivera was alert and the score remained the same.
47' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
46' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vicente Moreno probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Juan Cruz. He is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
46' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+9' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+6' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but Antonio Sivera punches the ball away. Now Osasuna have a corner.
45+4' Having seen unsporting behavior, Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Kike Barja (Osasuna) is the recipient.
45+4' Neat passing move from Alaves in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 8 additional min. will be played.
37' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' The game is interrupted now, Moussa Diarra (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' A goal, which was scored by Kike Garcia (Alaves), was disallowed due to offside.
32' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Osasuna! Play can continue.
30' There's a break in play and referee Cesar Soto Grado must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Osasuna using VAR. This could be interesting!
29' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
27' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' Carlos Martin (Alaves) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
26' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
25' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
24' Osasuna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
23' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
20' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
16' Dangerous play by Antonio Blanco (Alaves). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
11' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box.
9' Good movement by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
8' Joan Jordan (Alaves) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
8' Joan Jordan (Alaves) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
7' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) jumps into a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul. Alaves are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
7' Joan Jordan (Alaves) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
7' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Alaves earn a corner.
5' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! Carlos Martin plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Kike Garcia (Alaves), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
Alaves will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Cesar Soto Grado.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
